phaseLabel: Phase 0: Phonetic Foundation & Silent Letter Logic
title: Phonetics, Orthography & High-Frequency Greetings
description: Master French sounds (nasals, guttural R, liaison) and silent letter rules before learning vocabulary to avoid fossilizing bad pronunciation.
grammarKeypoints: IPA French Vowels & Nasal Vowels (an/en, in/ain, on, un)
Consonants & The French R / Dental T and D
Silent final consonants (D, P, S, T, X, Z) vs CaReFuL rule (C, R, F, L)
Liaison & Enchaînement (linking words smoothly)
Subject Pronouns (je, tu, il/elle/on, nous, vous, ils/elles)
activeRequirements: Accurately pronounce all 4 French nasal vowels without sounding out the N
Understand the distinction between Tu (तू/तुम) and Vous (आप)
Recite numbers 0-100 and spell out names using French alphabet sounds

phaseLabel: Phase 1: Basic Structural Mechanics & Daily Interactions
title: Present Tense, Passé Composé & Core 1,000 Lexicon
description: Construct solid affirmative, negative, and interrogative sentences. Master regular verb groups and essential irregulars (être, avoir, faire, aller).
grammarKeypoints: Regular verb groups: -er (90% of verbs), -ir, -re in Présent
Auxiliary verbs: ÊTRE and AVOIR mastery
Passé Composé with Avoir vs DR & MRS VANDERTRAMP verbs with Être
Negation structures: ne... pas, ne... jamais, ne... rien
Articles: Definite (le, la, les), Indefinite (un, une, des), Partitive (du, de la, des)
Near Future: Futur Proche (aller + infinitive)
activeRequirements: Introduce yourself, family, profession, daily routine, and immediate surroundings
Form questions using 3 methods (Intonation, Est-ce que, Inversion)
Complete 15 minutes of daily Anki SRS retrieval without missing reviews

title: Imparfait vs Passé Composé, Object Pronouns & Oral Shadowing
description: Tell complete stories in the past. Differentiate between completed past actions and ongoing background descriptions. Begin active vocal shadowing.
grammarKeypoints: Passé Composé vs Imparfait (Crucial narrative distinction)
Direct Object Pronouns (COD: me, te, le, la, nous, vous, les)
Indirect Object Pronouns (COI: me, te, lui, nous, vous, leur)
Pronoun Placement before the conjugated verb
Reflexive verbs in past tense with agreement rules
Comparatives and Superlatives (plus... que, moins... que, le meilleur)
activeRequirements: Listen to InnerFrench episodes with and without transcripts
Actively shadow (record and mimic) 3 minutes of audio per session
Describe past vacations, childhood memories, and daily challenges spontaneously

title: Subjonctif, Conditionnel, Pronouns Y/EN & News Auditory Parsing
description: Express doubt, necessity, emotions, and hypothetical scenarios. Transition from educational audio to real-time native broadcasts and Québécois listening.
grammarKeypoints: Subjonctif Présent (Necessity, emotion, doubt triggers: il faut que, bien que)
Conditionnel Présent (Politeness, hypothetical situations with SI clauses)
Pronoun Y (places & à + noun) and Pronoun EN (quantities & de + noun)
Double pronoun order (e.g., Il me le donne / Il lui en parle)
Futur Simple and Relative Pronouns (qui, que, où, dont)
Logical Connectors (en revanche, par conséquent, toutefois, néanmoins)
activeRequirements: Shadow RFI Journal en français facile 4x weekly
Listen to Québécois accent audio clips weekly to calibrate Canadian ear
Write 150-word opinion paragraphs defending a viewpoint with 3 distinct arguments

phaseLabel: Phase 4: TEF/TCF Canada Exam Precision & High Speed
title: Official FEI/CCIP Mock Mastery, Section A/B Roleplays & Formal Writing
description: Full timed simulations under real exam room pressure. Section A 5-minute inquiry drills, Section B 10-minute persuasion debates, and 200-word formal letter writing.
grammarKeypoints: Subjonctif Passé & Conditionnel Passé (Regrets and past hypotheses)
Advanced Discourse Markers (d’un côté... d’un autre côté, force est de constater)
Nominalization (converting verbs to formal nouns for writing economy)
Stylistic inversion and formal register vocabulary
Canadian French colloquial and formal lexical equivalents
activeRequirements: Score consistently above CLB/NCLC 7 in official FEI/CCIP full timed sample papers
Deliver fluid 10-minute Section B persuasion speeches handling examiner objections without pause
Complete 200-word Section B formal writing pieces in under 25 minutes with zero gender/conjugation errors
